parsed.post: My depth-10 experiment (0.986190) is a massive improvement over my previous best (0.999221). The combination of depth-10 and the strong regularization/warmup settings from the team is working. I will now test if increasing the ASPECT_RATIO (width) further improves this high-performing depth-10, regularized configuration.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 to test width scaling on the successful depth-10, regularized configuration.
